Pasatru (garetosmab-grts) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-756214  
Guideline Name 
Pasatru (garetosmab-grts)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
11/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Pasatru  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva (FOP)  


--- PDF page 1376 ---
Page 1376 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Disease is confirmed by clinical signs and symptoms of FOP (e.g., malformation of the 
great toes, episodic soft tissue swelling, progressive heterotopic ossification [HO])  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming the presence of ACVR1 
gene mutation  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 Used to reduce formation of new heterotopic ossification (HO) lesions and clinician-
assessed flare-ups  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Geneticist  
• 
Orthopedic physician  
• 
Rheumatologist  
• 
Endocrinologist  
 
AND 
 
4 - Requested drug will not be used in combination with other treatments for FOP (e.g., 
Atebrioz, Sohonos)  
 
Product Name:Pasatru  


--- PDF page 1377 ---
Page 1377 
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting that patient demonstrates 
positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., reductions in the number of new heterotopic 
ossification [HO] lesions)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Requested drug will not be used in combination with other treatments for FOP (e.g., 
Atebrioz, Sohonos)
